extracted.intended_audience: NIH extramural community (applicants, institutions, PIs, grant administrators, NIH staff)
extracted.subtask_description: Official NIH guidance describing policy changes and procedural allowances for extramural grants, post-submission materials, peer review, eligibility, and administrative deadlines following the October 1, 2025 lapse in appropriations.

rubrics_metrics.name: Rescheduling October application due dates
rubrics_metrics.description: All grant applications submitted late for due dates between October 1, 2025, and December 5, 2025, will be accepted through 5:00 PM local time December 8, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: There is no additional 2-week late window. This notice applies to all relevant Notices of Funding Opportunity (NOFO), including those that indicate no late applications will be accepted. Institutions need not request advance permission to submit late due to the government shutdown and a cover letter providing a justification is not required.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-submission materials deadline for January 2026 Council
rubrics_metrics.description: For applications for January 2026 Council, NIH will accept post-submission materials up to one week before the scheduled peer review meeting.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Acceptance of post-submission materials follows the types described in NOT-OD-19-083; submit by the one-week-before-meeting cutoff for January 2026 Council.

rubrics_metrics.name: Post-submission preliminary data allowance for May 2026 Council
rubrics_metrics.description: For applications for May 2026 Council, NIH will accept a one-page update with preliminary data as post-submission materials only if the NOFO used for submission allowed preliminary data in the application.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: One page of preliminary data will be accepted for single component applications or for each component of a multi-component application. The deadline for submitting all post-submission materials, including preliminary data, will be 30 days before the study section meeting. All other materials listed in NOT-OD-19-083 as acceptable post-submission materials will continue to be accepted if submitted 30 days before the study section meeting. Instructions for submission are included in NOT-OD-19-083.

rubrics_metrics.name: RPPR submissions during the shutdown
rubrics_metrics.description: Recipients that submitted their Research Performance Progress Reports (RPPR) that were due between October 1 and November 13 should not have to resubmit their reports.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Resubmission is only required if the institution receives a request from the funding Institute, Center, or Office (ICO). If you had submission challenges during the shutdown, contact staff at the appropriate ICO.

rubrics_metrics.name: Reduction in percent of applications discussed at peer review
rubrics_metrics.description: The percent of applications discussed in most meetings will be reduced to 30-35%, instead of the current ~50%.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: This modification is to manage the volume of missed meetings and catch-up workload caused by the shutdown.

rubrics_metrics.name: Designation of middle and lowest third applications
rubrics_metrics.description: Applications voted by the committee to be in the middle third will be designated as 'competitive but not discussed' and applications in the lowest third will be designated as 'not competitive and not discussed.'
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applications in the middle third will be considered for funding, along with the discussed applications.

rubrics_metrics.name: Simplified summary statements
rubrics_metrics.description: Summary statements will be simplified: narrative paragraphs summarizing committee discussion will not be used.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Summaries will have a sentence describing the degree of consensus in the committee vote, plus bullets listing the main score-driving points. Summaries for all applications will contain the written critiques from the 3 assigned reviewers, as is currently the case. Summaries for applications that are discussed will have the overall impact score.

rubrics_metrics.name: Duration of modified peer review practices
rubrics_metrics.description: The modifications in peer review practices outlined (reduced discussion percentage, designations, simplified summaries) will be in place through the May 2026 Advisory Council.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Modifications are temporary to manage overlap between January and May 2026 council review workloads.

rubrics_metrics.name: Early Stage Investigator (ESI) eligibility adjustment
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH will automatically adjust the Early Stage Investigator (ESI) status for applicants whose status has changed during the period of delay caused by the shutdown.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: No action required by applicants; NIH will make the adjustment to preserve eligibility affected by the delay.

rubrics_metrics.name: K99/R00 timeline update
rubrics_metrics.description: Information updating timelines for the K99/R00 NIH Pathway to Independence Award program will be issued separately.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Applicants and administrators should await the separate guidance specific to K99/R00 timelines.

rubrics_metrics.name: Loan Repayment Program (LRP) submission deadline
rubrics_metrics.description: The Extramural LRP Application Submission Deadline is now December 4, 2025.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to NOT-OD-26-010 for more details about the change.

rubrics_metrics.name: Payment Management System (PMS) drawdowns and processing
rubrics_metrics.description: Payments through the Payment Management System should be processing as usual.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: If recipients received a communication during the shutdown that a drawdown request was on hold, contact PMS directly to determine the status of that pending request.

rubrics_metrics.name: Financial operations under a continuing resolution
rubrics_metrics.description: NIH will publish a Notice on financial operations under a continuing resolution within the next few business days.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Refer to NOT-OD-26-011 when published for details about financial operations under a continuing resolution.

rubrics_metrics.name: Point of contact for inquiries
rubrics_metrics.description: All inquiries regarding this guidance should be directed to the NIH Office of Policy for Extramural Research Administration.
rubrics_metrics.guidance: Contact via the provided email: [email protected].
